case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Synthetic responses distinguished from human empirical evidence, with an authorised research/ethics scope for the changed design.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: N029 prohibits data fabrication, falsification, and misrepresentation (vp 119) and mandates prior ethics approval for human-participant research (4.7) and accurate data records (4.17).
case_summary.case_note: Code of Conduct: Research (N029) prohibits data fabrication or misrepresentation and requires prior HREC ethics approval for human-participant research, enforced through N030. While AI synthetic participant simulation is not explicitly named and the linked ethics-approval policy/procedures are not included in the bundle, the existing prohibitions protect against unapproved protocol deviation and disguised synthetic data; Protocol v1.1 critical-risk criteria were adopted after preliminary review.
